tool_args.rationale: The signatures and subtree guidance point to the coupled two-state siphon-memory mechanism, but the current five rows are insufficiently informative for its five parameters. Acquire the available fine trajectory batch to improve identifiability before fitting; do not pay for the irrelevant auxiliary measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows do not adequately identify five nonlinear parameters; the supplied mechanism guidance recommends at least eight rows before fitting.
It is explicitly a nuisance measurement and does not resolve the parameter-identifiability gap.
The pilot reports no narrow s_grad collinearity, and this probe is not present in the available cost menu.
